name: 37179 · Thompsons Stn, TN
findings: ZIP 37179 (Thompsons Stn) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37179 (Thompsons Stn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37179 (Thompsons Stn) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
